iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear risk inches higher: fresh feeds show Kazakhstan remains discussed as a possible holder for Iran enriched uranium, US-Iran deal terms are still unresolved, and Iranian officials publicly pushed back on negotiation terms. Declared 60 percent enrichment remains the standing technical driver; no top-level enrichment jump or device event found.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Iran/Gulf conventional risk remains imminent: regional feeds keep Hormuz-control threats, US readiness language, and strike reporting in circulation. Oil markets eased on deal optimism, but maritime and infrastructure risk remain the live escalation drivers.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon is still the sharpest regional conventional flashpoint: fresh feeds report Israeli schools and beaches closed near the border, forces expanding operations beyond the Litani area, Beirut-area strike fallout, and continuing military talks that have not stopped operations.

turkey.name: TURKEY / EAST MED
turkey.notes: Turkey/East Mediterranean remains deterrent: the 24h scan did not surface a fresh interstate clash, official atomic warning, or crisis-level force surge. Current items remain mostly posture analysis and older maritime/NATO rivalry context.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains high elevated but eases one point: prior Operation Sindoor 2.0 readiness rhetoric still matters, but this scan did not confirm a new cross-border strike or mobilization spike.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO remains imminent by spillover context and strategic-warning rhetoric. Fresh open feeds were thinner than yesterday, but Romanian-drone fallout and standing Russian official warning posture keep the risk elevated; no confirmed direct NATO-Russia combat exchange found.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan stays elevated and slightly lower: no fresh blockade, amphibious surge, or official atomic warning crossed threshold in this scan. Background PLA activity and gray-zone pressure remain the baseline.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea remains critical: prior projectile and guided-rocket reporting remains the active driver, but no new device event or major launch wave was found in the 24h scan.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine/NATO spillover remains the top systemic driver: feeds report a major Ukrainian drone attack after Moscow shunned ceasefire offers, plus continued NATO concern over spillover incidents. Strategic rhetoric keeps the nuclear-adjacent tail risk active.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains critical but slips one point: Taliban/Pakistan border-outpost reporting from the previous cycle is still relevant, but no stronger fresh 24h escalation trigger was found.

sudan.name: SUDAN / RED SEA SPILLOVER
sudan.notes: Sudan/Red Sea spillover remains critical-low by carry-forward external-backing and force-posture risk; this scan did not find a new Red Sea spillover trigger.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE / GAZA
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza risk remains imminent: fresh feeds report Hamas warning of dangerous escalation after Israeli orders to seize more Gaza land, while ceasefire confusion and continuing force-use risk keep the off-ramp weak.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated and softer: residual instability persists, but no fresh 24h clash trigger crossed the auto-detection threshold.
